guidance: Threat modeling identifies threat actors, attack paths, and potential impact on each workload's confidentiality, integrity, and availability — enabling security teams to prioritize investments rather than block innovation. Perform threat modeling per workload during the design phase, mapping threats to MITRE ATT&CK techniques for AWS environments. Use AWS Threat Composer (open source) to accelerate the process and the AWS Threat Technique Catalog for AWS-specific attack patterns.
how_to_check: Is threat modeling performed during the design phase of critical workloads? Are identified threats mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and tracked to resolution? Are structured tools (e.g., Threat Composer, STRIDE) used for consistency? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
